frequency_question: How often does a proposed industrial subsidy/financing scheme reach final implementation within roughly 9 months of initial targeting?
membership_rule: Includes major announced central government manufacturing/transportation subsidy schemes, credit guarantee frameworks, and financial incentive packages. Excludes minor budgetary line-item modifications or general annual budget allocations.
window: 270 days from formal proposal/initiation to formal notification

validity_reason: Administrative machinery and bureaucratic processes for industrial incentive rollouts remain stable across medium-term electoral cycles.
